chat.runnerUnavailable: The assistant runner is not available right now.
chat.readOnly: You can read conversations but not write (plugin write permission required).
chat.notOwner: This conversation belongs to another user (read-only).
chat.streamLost: Lost the live connection to the runner; the transcript was reloaded.
chat.notAuthenticatedAdmin: Sign in with your Claude subscription or store an API key in the plugin settings.
chat.notAuthenticatedUser: Ask an administrator to connect the assistant.
chat.title: AI assistant
chat.subtitle: Claude Code in a sandboxed workspace
chat.pickOne: Pick a conversation or start a new one.
chat.emptyHint: Claude Code works inside the shared AI workspace repository and knows this Lyndrix installation through the generated instructions. Tool calls ask for your permission.
chat.freshSession: New conversation — describe what you want Claude to look at or do.

session.archiveBody: "{{title}}" is closed in the runner and moved to the archive. The transcript stays readable.

composer.running: Claude is working — wait or interrupt…
composer.placeholder: Ask Claude about this installation… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line)
composer.hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter inserts a line break · tool calls may ask for your permission.

approval.title: Permission requested
approval.allowAlwaysHint: Allow this tool for the rest of the session without asking again.

settings.title: AI assistant
settings.subtitle: Claude Code in a sandboxed runner container — status, sign-in and workspace.
settings.syncHint: Pull the workspace repository and regenerate CLAUDE.md from every plugin's AI instructions.
settings.restartHint: Recreate the runner container with the current settings (credential, model, image).
settings.coreSettingsHint: Credential, model, permission mode, workspace repository, allowed Vault spaces and other guardrails are edited in the plugin settings dialog (gear icon on the Plugins page).
settings.readOnly: Sign-in, workspace sync and runner control require the plugin admin permission.

login.runnerNeeded: The runner must be up to sign in — start or restart it first.
login.successRestarting: Signed in. The token is stored in Vault and the runner restarts with it.
login.title: Claude sign-in
login.body: Sign in with a Claude Pro/Max subscription: the runner opens a Claude login, you confirm it in the browser and paste the code shown there. The resulting long-lived token is stored in Vault (plugin setting claude_oauth_token). An API key can be stored in the plugin settings instead.
login.runnerAuthenticated: The runner reports a valid Claude login.
login.runnerNotAuthenticated: A credential is configured but the runner does not report a valid login — the token may have expired.
login.pendingHint: A sign-in is already pending in the runner; starting again replaces it.
login.step1: Open the Claude login page and confirm the access:
login.urlUnknown: (URL not available — start the sign-in again to get a fresh link)
login.step2: Paste the code shown after the confirmation:
login.expired: The sign-in request expired — start again.

instructions.title: Generated instructions (CLAUDE.md)
instructions.body: Read-only preview of the CLAUDE.md the plugin writes into the workspace: the Lyndrix base instructions, every loaded plugin's ai_instructions and the operator's extra instructions. Regenerated on every workspace sync.
instructions.empty: (empty — the workspace has not been synchronised yet)
